name: Why does flooring in a foreclosed property cost more than I expected?
description: Foreclosed properties often cost more because of extra prep, demo, and hidden repairs. The final price depends heavily on what’s underneath the old flooring.

mainEntity.name: Why does flooring in a foreclosed property cost more than I expected?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost is driven by demolition, disposal, subfloor repair, and the flooring material you choose. Foreclosed homes often cost more than a normal replacement because the contractor may need to fix water damage, level the floor, or replace sections before installation.
